# Finishing preflight: PR acme/widget#12 rework, stopped before the menu

## SHA legend

| Label | SHA |
|---|---|
| H (original home #12, `PRE_REWORK_HEAD`) | `aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa` |
| M (original member #13) | `cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc` |
| R (Rework base) | `dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd` |
| E (HEAD) | `eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee` |
| O (origin/retry in variants B and C) | `9999999999999999999999999999999999999999` |

## Proof commands

These are shared by A, B and C. Nothing is executed at this checkpoint.

```bash
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/retry fetch origin
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/retry merge-base --is-ancestor aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa HEAD   # home first
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/retry merge-base --is-ancestor cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc HEAD   # member #13
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/retry merge-base --is-ancestor origin/retry HEAD                               # home only
```

The record states that E contains R but not H. So the first proof (H against HEAD) exits 1. That is the first nonzero exit, so it stops the preflight:

```
PR branch history was rewritten: aaaaaaa is not an ancestor of HEAD; the rework must be re-merged, not rebased.
```

The member proof for #13 and the origin/retry proof are never reached.

## Variant outcomes

| Variant | origin/retry state | Preflight result | Menu |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | Differs from H, descends from R, is an ancestor of E | Stops at the H proof | None |
| B | O is an ancestor of E but does not descend from R | Stops at the H proof | None |
| C | O descends from R but is not an ancestor of E | Stops at the H proof | None |

**A.** No push command is selected. This skill has no lease or force push for a PR-subject rework: its only push is the non-force `git push --no-follow-tags origin HEAD:refs/heads/retry`, and that push is reachable only after the history proof passes. A `--force-with-lease` push is a forbidden force-push, even though an earlier run already performed one.
- Both existing original refs stay as they are and nothing rewrites them: `refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-12` keeps H and `refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-13` keeps M.
- No thread-fix commit range is computed. That range would be `<merge-sha | aaaaaaa>..HEAD`, and it is undefined while H is not an ancestor of HEAD. Threads remain `none`.

**B and C.** The "push withheld: origin/retry is at 9999999…" reason and its separate R-advance proof never apply, because the stop comes earlier. So no withheld menu is rendered, and rows 1, 5 and 6 are not offered.
- A bare `1`, `5` or `6` reply therefore has no menu to select from, and nothing is pushed or kept.
- The row-6 discard flow does not start, so no discard warning or `discard` confirmation is shown. Origin's `retry` branch is not deleted on any path.

## Returning after origin changes

If origin/retry moves and you come back to the menu, the preflight runs again from the fetch. The H proof depends only on local HEAD, not on origin. So the same stop repeats whatever origin/retry now points to.

Two ways out:
1. Re-merge the rework so that H (and M) are ancestors of HEAD, for example by merging onto a head that contains `aaaaaaa`, and then rerun finishing.
2. Handle the rebased branch by hand outside this skill.

The ship phase stays incomplete. No strip, seal, push, body edit or closure happens.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
### Shared SHA legend

| Symbol | SHA / meaning |
|---|---|
| `HOME` | `aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa` — original PR #12 head |
| `MEMBER` | `cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc` — original PR #13 head |
| `REWORK` | `dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd` — recorded rework base |
| `HEAD` | `eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee` — current local tip |
| `REMOTE-BC` | `9999999999999999999999999999999999999999` — B/C remote tip |

### Shared preflight commands

These are the prescribed commands, shown only—not executed:

```bash
git -C "/work/widget/.worktrees/retry" fetch origin

git -C "/work/widget/.worktrees/retry" merge-base --is-ancestor \
  aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa HEAD
```

After a successful fetch, the first ancestry proof must test the **original home head**, not the rework base. The supplied facts say `HEAD` does not contain `HOME`, so that proof exits 1. The required stop is:

```text
PR branch history was rewritten: aaaaaaa is not an ancestor of HEAD; the rework must be re-merged, not rebased.
```

### A/B/C disposition

| Variant | Supplied remote relationship | Preflight result |
|---|---|---|
| A | `origin/retry` descends from `REWORK` and is an ancestor of `HEAD` | Stop at the original-home proof |
| B | `origin/retry` is an ancestor of `HEAD`, but does not descend from `REWORK` | Same stop |
| C | `origin/retry` descends from `REWORK`, but is not an ancestor of `HEAD` | Same stop |

The remote relationships do not change this result. The skill requires the original-head proofs first, home before members, and stops at the first failed proof. Consequently, neither the member-head proof nor the remote-tip proof is reached in any variant.

The retained original refs preserve handles to the original commits; they do not establish that those commits remain ancestors of `HEAD`. Likewise, an empty member replay, the reported zero stops during rebasing, and a previous successful lease push do not satisfy or waive the original-history requirement. `REWORK` cannot replace `HOME` as the proof boundary.

**No push command or finishing menu is available at this checkpoint.** In particular, B/C cannot enter the withheld-push menu: that menu applies only after every original-head ancestry proof passes. Bare replies `1`, `5`, and `6` therefore have no displayed selection here, and discard confirmation is not reached.

If origin changes, returning to preflight requires fetching again and rerunning the ordered proofs. An origin-only change cannot repair the stated local ancestry failure. The rework must first be re-merged rather than rebased; no downstream action is taken here.
